Premier Explosives Limited has informed the Exchange about Copy of Newspaper Publication
voiceSummary: Premier Explosives Limited filed a notice regarding the newspaper publication of Unaudited Financial Results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The results were published in Business Standard and Nava Telangana. Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited, formerly Taj GVK Hotels and Resorts Limited, reported Standalone and Consolidated Unaudited Financial Results for the quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026. The Board of Directors approved the results on November 12, 2026. The company received dividend income of Rs. 2,295 lakhs from its subsidiary Green Woods Palaces and Resorts Private Limited during the quarter. The company name change to Krishna GVK Luxury Hotels Limited was approved by members on September 9, 2026, and effective from October 30, 2026. The company is engaged in hoteliering operations within India.

attchmntText: Premier Explosives Limited has informed the Exchange about Presentation
voiceSummary: Premier Explosives Limited filed a presentation on its second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026 results with the Stock Exchange. The company reported revenue of Rs 1,452.8 Mn for Q2 FY27, up 92% year-on-year. Profit after tax was Rs 119.7 Mn for the quarter. For the half year, revenue stood at Rs 2,478.4 Mn, with profit after tax at Rs 150.0 Mn. The company holds an order book of Rs 16,420 Mn. Apollo Micro Systems acquired a 26% stake in the company for Rs 705.65 per share on November 4, 2026. Apollo Micro Systems is acquiring a 41.33% promoter stake for approximately Rs 1,550 Cr in cash. This transaction is expected to close in Q3 FY27, subject to approvals.

attchmntText: Premier Explosives Limited has submitted to the Exchange, the financial results for the period ended September 30, 2026.
voiceSummary: Premier Explosives Limited announced the approval of its unaudited financial results for the second quarter and half year ended September 30, 2026, by its Board of Directors on November 12, 2026. The standalone revenue from operations for the quarter was Rs. 14,527.63 lakhs, with a profit after tax of Rs. 1,196.79 lakhs. For the six-month period, standalone revenue from operations stood at Rs. 24,783.98 lakhs, and profit after tax was Rs. 1,499.90 lakhs. Earnings per share for the quarter were Rs. 2.23. The statutory auditors issued an unmodified opinion on the reviewed results. The company reported total assets of Rs. 54,210.77 lakhs as of September 30, 2026.
